name: web-blue-kanban-task-board-with-integration-chips-and-avatars
title: Blue Kanban Task Board
whatItIs: A white app window with a sidebar (menu and messaging integrations, dark mode toggle), a Tasks header with table, list and kanban tabs, an avatar stack and a blue Create Task button, and four columns (To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done) of cards with dates, source-app chips and avatar stacks, some with image covers.
whatItMeans: Colour-coded column titles and source chips make a busy board scannable, and one blue accent keeps it clean.
techniques: Active sidebar item as a blue filled pill

vocabulary.definition: A board with columns showing task status.
A small label showing which app a task came from.
Overlapping avatars with a remainder count.
